verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents several background automations. Alerts notify via Slack, GitHub Actions, or webhooks when metrics or spend cross thresholds. Blob Storage Export runs large exports on a schedule. Managed LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators automatically score a sample of live production traces. However, these are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a general facility for defining arbitrary autonomous background workflows. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder or scheduler, autonomous agent-driven actions beyond notifications, evaluation and export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
